name: @spexcode/spec-eval
description: The eval/loss engine — eval.md declares scenarios, a flat evals.ndjson sidecar records readings (a second git-as-database axis), freshness compares each reading's stored scenario-contract hash and git ancestry on its governed code, and evidence lives content-addressed under the shared git common dir. `spex eval add|ls|scenario ls|lint|retract|clean`.
